description: Generate a solution, evaluate it against explicit pass/fail criteria, refine using the feedback, repeat until it passes or a round cap is hit. Use for tasks with a clear, checkable bar and demonstrable value from iteration — a bug fix that must pass a test suite, code that must satisfy a lint/style rubric, a document that must meet stated requirements. Distinct from advisor-checkpoint (one strategic consult before committing) — this is a convergence loop against a concrete standard.
